passages.text: “Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel, who have descended from the line of Judah, who swear by the name of the LORD, who invoke the God of Israel— but not in truth or righteousness— who indeed call yourselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel; the LORD of Hosts is His name.
passages.sermon:
The house of Jacob must listen to this.
You are called by the name of Israel.
You have come from the line of Judah.
You swear by the name of the LORD.
You mention the God of Israel.
You do not do this in truth.
You do not do this in righteousness.
You call yourselves people of the holy city.
You rely on the God of Israel.
His name is the LORD of Hosts.
passages.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֣את בֵּֽית־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַנִּקְרָאִים֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִמֵּ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יָצָ֑אוּ הַֽנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים׀ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וּבֵאלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א בֶאֱמֶ֖ת וְלֹ֥א בִצְדָקָֽה׃ כִּֽי־ מֵעִ֤יר הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ נִקְרָ֔אוּ וְעַל־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִסְמָ֑כוּ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: I foretold the former things long ago; they came out of My mouth and I proclaimed them. Suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God told them about things that would happen in the future.
God spoke these things a long time ago.
God Himself announced these things.
God acted suddenly.
Everything God said happened.
passages.original: הָרִֽאשֹׁנוֹת֙ מֵאָ֣ז הִגַּ֔דְתִּי וּמִפִּ֥י יָצְא֖וּ וְאַשְׁמִיעֵ֑ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם עָשִׂ֖יתִי וַתָּבֹֽאנָה׃

passages.text: For I knew that you are stubborn; your neck is iron and your forehead is bronze.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the house of Jacob.
God knows their character.
They are stubborn.
Their neck is hard like iron.
Their forehead is hard like bronze.
passages.original: מִדַּעְתִּ֕י כִּ֥י קָשֶׁ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וְגִ֤יד בַּרְזֶל֙ עָרְפֶּ֔ךָ וּמִצְחֲךָ֖ נְחוּשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: Therefore I declared it to you long ago; I announced it before it came to pass, so that you could not claim, ‘My idol has done this; my carved image and molten god has ordained it.’
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Israel.
God declared things to Israel a long time ago.
God announced these things before they happened.
God did this so Israel could not say, “My idol did this.”
God did this so Israel could not say, “My carved image and my metal god commanded this.”
passages.original: וָאַגִּ֤יד לְךָ֙ מֵאָ֔ז בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֑יךָ פֶּן־ תֹּאמַר֙ עָצְבִּ֣י עָשָׂ֔ם וּפִסְלִ֥י וְנִסְכִּ֖י צִוָּֽם׃

passages.text: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not acknowledge them? From now on I will tell you of new things, hidden things unknown to you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God says, “You have heard these things.”
Look at all these things.
Will you not admit what you have seen and heard?
From now on, I will tell you new things.
These new things are hidden.
You did not know these things before.
passages.original: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּֽ חֲזֵה֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְאַתֶּ֖ם הֲל֣וֹא תַגִּ֑ידוּ הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֤יךָ חֲדָשׁוֹת֙ מֵעַ֔תָּה וּנְצֻר֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

passages.text: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot claim, ‘I already knew them!’
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God creates new things now.
God did not create these things long ago.
You did not hear about these things before today.
You cannot say, "I already knew them."
passages.original: עַתָּ֤ה נִבְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מֵאָ֔ז וְלִפְנֵי־ י֖וֹם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתָּ֑ם פֶּן־ תֹּאמַ֖ר הִנֵּ֥ה יְדַעְתִּֽין׃

passages.text: You have never heard; you have never understood; for a long time your ears have not been open. For I knew how deceitful you are; you have been called a rebel from birth.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
You have not listened.
You have not understood.
Your ears have been closed for a long time.
God knows you are deceitful.
You have been a rebel since you were born.
passages.original: גַּ֣ם לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ גַּ֚ם לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ גַּ֕ם מֵאָ֖ז לֹא־ פִתְּחָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ בָּג֣וֹד תִּבְגּ֔וֹד וּפֹשֵׁ֥עַ מִבֶּ֖טֶן קֹ֥רָא לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: For the sake of My name I will delay My wrath; for the sake of My praise I will restrain it, so that you will not be cut off.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God has called Israel.
God delays His anger for the sake of His name.
God restrains His wrath for the sake of His praise.
God does this so that He will not destroy Israel.
passages.original: לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִי֙ אַאֲרִ֣יךְ אַפִּ֔י וּתְהִלָּתִ֖י אֶחֱטָם־ לָ֑ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י הַכְרִיתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: See, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, “I have refined you.”
I did not refine you as people refine silver.
I tested you.
I tested you in the furnace of affliction.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֥ה צְרַפְתִּ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א בְכָ֑סֶף בְּחַרְתִּ֖יךָ בְּכ֥וּר עֹֽנִי׃

passages.text: For My own sake, My very own sake, I will act; for how can I let Myself be defamed? I will not yield My glory to another.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, “I will act for My own sake.
I will do this for My very own sake.
I will not let My name be dishonored.
I will not give My glory to anyone else.”
passages.original: לְמַעֲנִ֧י לְמַעֲנִ֛י אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣יךְ יֵחָ֑ל וּכְבוֹדִ֖י לְאַחֵ֥ר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּֽן׃ס

passages.text: Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel, whom I have called: I am He; I am the first, and I am the last.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Jacob and Israel.
God has called Jacob and Israel.
God says, "Listen to Me."
God says, "I am He."
God says, "I am the first."
God says, "I am the last."
passages.original: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־ הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַחֲרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Surely My own hand founded the earth, and My right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they stand up together.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God says He created everything.
God’s own hand made the earth.
God’s right hand spread out the heavens.
God calls to the earth and heavens.
When God calls, they stand up together.
passages.original: אַף־ יָדִי֙ יָ֣סְדָה אֶ֔רֶץ וִֽימִינִ֖י טִפְּחָ֣ה שָׁמָ֑יִם קֹרֵ֥א אֲנִ֛י אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יַעַמְד֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃

passages.text: Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of the idols has foretold these things? The LORD’s chosen ally will carry out His desire against Babylon, and His arm will be against the Chaldeans.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God calls everyone to gather together.
God commands all to listen.
God asks a question.
God says, “Which of the idols has announced these things?”
God declares that the LORD loves His chosen ally.
God says His chosen ally will do what God desires in Babylon.
God says His power will be against the Chaldeans.
passages.original: הִקָּבְצ֤וּ כֻלְּכֶם֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔עוּ מִ֥י בָהֶ֖ם הִגִּ֣יד אֶת־ אֵ֑לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֲהֵב֔וֹ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה חֶפְצוֹ֙ בְּבָבֶ֔ל וּזְרֹע֖וֹ כַּשְׂדִּֽים׃

passages.text: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and he will succeed in his mission.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God alone has spoken these words.
God has called this person.
God has brought him.
This person will succeed in his mission.
passages.original: אֲנִ֥י אֲנִ֛י דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אַף־ קְרָאתִ֑יו הֲבִיאֹתִ֖יו וְהִצְלִ֥יחַ דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Come near to Me and listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it happened, I was there.” And now the Lord GOD has sent me, accompanied by His Spirit.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God calls people to come near to Him.
God tells them to listen to Him.
God says He has not spoken in secret from the beginning.
God says He was present from the time events began.
God says the Lord GOD has now sent Him.
God says He is sent with the Spirit of the Lord.
passages.original: קִרְב֧וּ אֵלַ֣י שִׁמְעוּ־ זֹ֗את לֹ֤א מֵרֹאשׁ֙ בַּסֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי מֵעֵ֥ת הֱיוֹתָ֖הּ שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי וְעַתָּ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֧י יְהוִ֛ה שְׁלָחַ֖נִי וְרוּחֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your benefit, who directs you in the way you should go.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is your Redeemer.
The LORD is the Holy One of Israel.
The LORD is your God.
The LORD teaches you to help you.
The LORD guides you in the way you should go.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְךָ֖ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מְלַמֶּדְךָ֣ לְהוֹעִ֔יל מַדְרִֽיכֲךָ֖ בְּדֶ֥רֶךְ תֵּלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: If only you had paid attention to My commandments, your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like waves of the sea.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God gives commandments.
God wants His people to listen to His commandments.
If you had listened to My commandments, you would have had great peace.
Your peace would have flowed like a river.
Your righteousness would have been strong and constant, like the waves of the sea.
passages.original: ל֥וּא הִקְשַׁ֖בְתָּ לְמִצְוֺתָ֑י וַיְהִ֤י כַנָּהָר֙ שְׁלוֹמֶ֔ךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֖ כְּגַלֵּ֥י הַיָּֽם׃

passages.text: Your descendants would have been as countless as the sand, and your offspring as numerous as its grains; their name would never be cut off or eliminated from My presence.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the Redeemer and the Holy One of Israel.
He speaks to His people.
He says this about their descendants.
Your descendants would be as countless as the sand.
Your offspring would be as many as the grains of sand.
Their name would never be cut off from Me.
Their name would never be destroyed from My presence.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֤י כַחוֹל֙ זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וְצֶאֱצָאֵ֥י מֵעֶ֖יךָ כִּמְעֹתָ֑יו לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֧ת וְֽלֹא־ יִשָּׁמֵ֛ד שְׁמ֖וֹ מִלְּפָנָֽי׃

passages.text: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare it with a shout of joy, proclaim it, let it go out to the ends of the earth, saying, “The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God called them His servant Jacob.
God told them to leave Babylon.
God told them to flee from the Chaldeans.
God commanded them to shout with joy.
God told them to announce this news.
God wanted them to proclaim it everywhere.
God said to spread the message to the ends of the earth.
God declared, “The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob.”
passages.original: צְא֣וּ מִבָּבֶל֮ בִּרְח֣וּ מִכַּשְׂדִּים֒ בְּק֣וֹל רִנָּ֗ה הַגִּ֤ידוּ הַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ זֹ֔את הוֹצִיא֖וּהָ עַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ אִמְר֕וּ גָּאַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַבְדּ֥וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts; He made water flow for them from the rock; He split the rock, and water gushed out.
passages.sermon:
God led His people through the deserts.
They did not become thirsty.
God made water flow for them from the rock.
God split the rock.
Water gushed out.
passages.original: וְלֹ֣א צָמְא֗וּ בָּחֳרָבוֹת֙ הֽוֹלִיכָ֔ם מַ֥יִם מִצּ֖וּר הִזִּ֣יל לָ֑מוֹ וַיִּ֨בְקַע־ צ֔וּר וַיָּזֻ֖בוּ מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: “There is no peace,” says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
passages.sermon: The LORD speaks.\r\nThe LORD says this clearly.\r\nThe LORD says, “There is no peace for the wicked.”
passages.original: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לָרְשָׁעִֽים׃ס
